replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
The "Bulletin" is a very professional looking report of what's been happening in the past week, but is struggling to have a sufficient amount of context to produce an infographic with any purpose.
Yet on the other hand...
The "AVPost" was more casual and less concerned on the presentation, but more on the reaction from the community, aiming for high levels of banter in a more blog style.

My vote? Both.


P.S: I'm certainly up for being a writer! ;)

.
